join.joinCondition: t1.person_id = person_name.person_id AND (person_name.voided IS NULL || person_name.voided = 0) AND person_name.preferred = 1
t1.person_id = contacts.person_id AND (contacts.voided IS NULL || contacts.voided = 0) AND contacts.person_attribute_type_id in (10)

columns.column: CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e_prev.encounter_id) FROM amrs.encounter e_prev WHERE e_prev.patient_id = et.patient_id AND e_prev.voided = 0 AND (e_prev.encounter_datetime < et.encounter_datetime OR (e_prev.encounter_datetime = et.encounter_datetime AND e_prev.encounter_id <= et.encounter_id))) = 1 THEN (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t1.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 55 AND (pi.voided IS NULL OR pi.voided = 0) ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END

CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e_prev.encounter_id) FROM amrs.encounter e_prev WHERE e_prev.patient_id = et.patient_id AND e_prev.voided = 0 AND (e_prev.encounter_datetime < et.encounter_datetime OR (e_prev.encounter_datetime = et.encounter_datetime AND e_prev.encounter_id <= et.encounter_id))) > 1 THEN (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t1.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 55 AND (pi.voided IS NULL OR pi.voided = 0) ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(cvm_ed.name, CAST(ed.diagnosis_coded AS CHAR)) ORDER BY ed.dx_rank SEPARATOR '; ') FROM amrs.encounter_diagnosis ed LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_ed ON cvm_ed.concept_id = ed.diagnosis_coded WHERE ed.patient_id = t1.person_id AND ed.encounter_id = et.encounter_id AND ed.voided = 0)

columns.column: (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(d.name, ''), cn.name) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(d.name, ''), cn.name) SEPARATOR '; ') FROM amrs.orders o INNER JOIN amrs.drug_order dro ON dro.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN amrs.drug d ON d.drug_id = dro.drug_inventory_id LEFT JOIN amrs.concept_name cn ON cn.concept_id = COALESCE(d.concept_id, o.concept_id) AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND cn.voided = 0 WHERE o.encounter_id IN (SELECT ev.encounter_id FROM amrs.encounter ev WHERE ev.visit_id = et.visit_id AND ev.voided = 0) AND o.voided = 0 AND COALESCE(o.order_action, 'NEW') <> 'DISCONTINUE')

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT COALESCE(cn.name, CAST(r.value_coded AS CHAR), r.value_text) FROM amrs.obs r LEFT JOIN amrs.concept_name cn ON cn.concept_id = r.value_coded AND cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND cn.voided = 0 WHERE r.encounter_id = et.encounter_id AND r.concept_id = 6749 AND r.voided = 0 ORDER BY r.obs_datetime DESC, r.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT COALESCE(cn.name, CAST(r.value_coded AS CHAR), r.value_text) FROM amrs.obs r LEFT JOIN amrs.concept_name cn ON cn.concept_id = r.value_coded AND cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND cn.voided = 0 WHERE r.encounter_id = et.encounter_id AND r.concept_id = 10927 AND r.voided = 0 ORDER BY r.obs_datetime DESC, r.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)
